scripts.build: npm run build -w @quizzical/shared && npm run build -w @quizzical/api && npm run build -w @quizzical/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c teal,cyan "npm run dev -w @quizzical/api" "npm run dev -w @quizzical/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @quizzical/shared && npm run test -w @quizzical/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @quizzical/shared && npm run lint -w @quizzical/api && npm run lint -w @quizzical/web
